title: Go Fast email deleted under the spillage protocol

tellings.quote: the story he told me what happened is when it was deleted they were still not sure whether it was adversary tech or or off-world

plain: An email carrying the "Go Fast" video, a 2015 Navy clip of a small object racing over the ocean, was deleted from Navy computer networks under the "spillage" rules, which are used to wipe secret material that ends up somewhere it should not be. A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet tells this, passing on what he says a Pentagon official named Jay Stratton told him: "when it was deleted they were still not sure whether it was adversary tech or or off-world." If true, it would mean the Navy erased the evidence before it knew whether the object was foreign or not from Earth at all.
